descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Don’t Touch the Floor is a high-intensity single-player VR parkour experience where the ground is completely covered in deadly lava. There are no enemies. No weapons. No shortcuts. Just you, your movement skills, and a massive 4-kilometer physics-driven obstacle course standing between survival and failure.

Built with full physics-based mechanics, every action matters. Grab ledges with precision, swing across gaps using ropes, wall-jump between structures, balance on unstable objects, and chain movements together using real momentum. Your body control and timing determine whether you land safely—or fall into the lava below.

The course pushes you constantly forward with dynamic obstacles, moving platforms, collapsing structures, tight jumps, and long aerial transfers that demand confidence and skill. Mastering the movement system is the key. The better your control, the smoother and faster you flow.

There are no easy wins here. One mistake can cost you progress. Every section challenges your reflexes, coordination, and nerves. Whether you play to improve your speed, perfect your parkour lines, or simply survive longer each run, the challenge keeps pulling you back for “one more try.”

Do you have the balance, focus, and control to conquer all 4 kilometers without touching the floor?

Step in. Stay sharp. And whatever you do… don’t touch the floor. 🔥
